Record revision: `2026-09-18-i4-functional-ready-v1`.

- **2026-09-18 / I4-LOCAL-SIGNOFF-READY** — Pinned frozen-encoder 80-byte XSim parity flow and real-AMU U50 risk-to-R01 OOC implementation flow are prepared for final I4 local evidence.
- **2026-09-18 / I4-DUAL-SOURCE-R01-GATE** — Focused R01-boundary regression proves ordinary and prebuild order sources both traverse risk, prebuild retains priority, and kill-switch rejection cannot reach the encoder contract.
- **2026-09-18 / I4-SHARED-CL-EX-OWNER** — Shared-core regression proves one futures-state/AMU owner across CL admission and committed execution, including OPEN-to-fill-to-CLOSE closed loop and execution priority under simultaneous acquisition.
- **2026-09-17 / I3-OOC-POSTROUTE** — Real-AMU I3 atomic CL2EX U50 OOC closes at 156.25 MHz: synth WNS +3.023 ns, routed WNS +1.583 ns, TNS 0, 2392 LUT, 2693 FF, 11 RAMB36 + 1 RAMB18, 10 DSP, zero routing errors, and the worst path remains inside the frozen AMU.
- **2026-09-17 / I3-HFT-ORDER-GATE** — Frozen-HFT order-gate regression closes exact account/product mapping, Side translation, mapping/policy fail-closed behavior, normalized context correctness and byte-identical accepted payload.
- **2026-09-17 / I3-ROLLBACK-FAIL-CLOSED** — Fault injection proves an admission rollback failure can never accept an order and is escalated to an explicit recovery-required system failure.
- **2026-09-17 / I3-ATOMIC-ADMISSION** — Atomic CL2EX admission regression proves policy/accounting no-mutation, successful reserve+insert, duplicate/full rollback, stable result backpressure and no leaked reservation after recoverable store failure.
- **2026-09-17 / I2-OOC-POSTROUTE** — Real-AMU I2 U50 OOC closes at 156.25 MHz after structural state/margin pipelining: routed WNS +1.078 ns, TNS 0, 3396 LUT, 2383 FF, 19 RAMB36 + 1 RAMB18, 10 DSP and zero routing errors.
